about.title: A clear reading, rooted in tradition
about.p1: Dreamscope exists to make dream interpretation accessible in your own language. We combine two streams of understanding: the classical Islamic dream scholarship of Ibn Sirin, one of the most influential dream interpreters in history, and the symbolic frameworks of modern depth psychology.
about.p2: Every reading is generated to help you reflect — not to predict the future. Symbols like water, fire, flight, or a snake have carried meaning across cultures for thousands of years, and our interpretations trace those threads so you can find what resonates with your own life.
about.p3: The service is free, private by design, and available in 60 languages. Your dream text is sent to our interpretation service to generate a reading, then is not stored by us; your readings stay on your device unless you sign in and sync.
about.card1Body: Classical Islamic dream scholarship, traced through centuries of interpretation.
about.card2Body: From Arabic to Japanese — interpret in the language you dream in.
about.card3Body: Dreams stay on your device. No accounts, no tracking.
about.traditionsLede: Pick the lens your heart trusts — each reading is generated through a dedicated interpretation school.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Dreamscope blends classical dream scholarship — including Ibn Sirin's tradition — with modern depth psychology. You describe a dream in your own words and receive a reading that maps its symbols to their common meanings across cultures.
faq.a2: Yes. Your dreams are stored only in your browser's local storage on your device. Nothing is sent to a server for storage, and you can delete your history at any time.
faq.q3: In which languages can I interpret dreams?
faq.a3: Dreamscope supports 60 languages including English, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Portuguese, Russian, Hindi, and more. The reading follows the language you choose.
faq.q4: Are the interpretations a substitute for professional advice?
faq.a4: No. Dream readings are for reflection and entertainment. They are not medical, psychological, or religious guidance. If you are struggling, please speak with a qualified professional.
faq.q5: How many dream symbols are covered?
faq.a5: Dreamscope has dedicated pages for 146 common symbols — snake, water, flying, fire, pregnancy, money, and many more — each available in multiple languages with long-tail question variants.
